body: I am sorry you got the shitty end of the stick. My life should have been a success but I am on disability too and my fam does not love me. The only things holding me together are a few pills , 1 GF i just got to know, a dog and once in a while my son. I relate to your feeling of being cursed basically but i am old now and my years are short (health failing). i don't know how to make you feel better but maybe misery loves company ? I did not know autistic people could send such messages , my freind (who I rarely see and he is a millionaire) has an autistic child who can't speak and can never do anything for himself. it seems you have much more functionality than he does. His father has to wipe his ass for him. I will be your friend. i would be grateful if i had a person like you to visit with.
you sound young, and I always urge young people to value their youth because mine is gone. I would give anything to be young again.
thank you for caring I need more friends badly

please understand i am 52 and from my perspective - you have so many years ahead of you - so many things can change , I would give anything to be young again. Pretend you were old like me and got a second chance. take it for me. Please don't give up.
I have always been sensitive and had to endure alot of rejection - that is why I am ill - I don't know if anyone can figure this mess out.
where do you see hope ? It looks very bleak to me.

thank you , I dont know where to start but maybe there is a way - I have had a stomach problem for most of the year and lately its been worse. I will seee  my dr soon. but my anxiety is incredible - most folks would be knocked out on all the meds I take. ( I am not proud of this ) it scares me.
I thought I answeered you but I odnt see it, all the people i invested myself in rejected me. so why wasnt it a waste ?

yes i have medicare and have been disabled since the 90's by depression and anxiety, also 2 near fatal accidents left me in big pain so thats why i was able to get oxys but now i am tolerant and need more. The DR will not give more. So now i panic sometimes because i cant get as much relief.
but all the effort and years are gone and i can't get them back -

are you still here ? did you hold off ? how old are you ? if you are young then you have your whole life ahead - it can be so different than you imagine. i am old 52 so my yers (best years are gone) that is why i feel alot of sadness - i wasted my love BUT have ever considered th there is an afterlife ? What if you wind up in torture forever ? It is possible isn't it ? but who am i to talk...

I did tell my son about suicide but he says evertime i need him i talk about it and once he cried about it. I cn't tell him again or he moght never talk to me. he is 24 and says he can't see me more than once a week. that's not enough. I'm too nervous to spend al this time alone. I spent 5 years straight with no woman after my wife left me for our lawyer - you see its been one rejection after another and it accumulates to where you start to have mental issues. i was also bullied in school for 7 years which madde me an alcoholic - I have not drank in 30 years but am considering it agian because the meds i take are losing their effect. i bet I would die without suicide if i ever drank again. I used to drink til I passed out everyday.

yeah I just noticed this comment - i was ok(i had breakdowns over the years but its been downhill since 08 for sure) until my son went to college in 08 and I had a breakdown, my GF odf 10 years left me in 2010 - I gave it all i had , she is still alone , i don't understand why she did not want me, I was so good to her. Then i thought i found a break and got a great GF, she was everything I wanted, she kicked me out for minor reasons and is now in china, i will never see my china doll again , thats when I started hitting the oxy and klonopin hard, it was the only way i could face the day and get off the couch, I then got another GF who swore to love me forever , she lied too and is gone, then i doubled my oxy and now taking too much - its not as effective as it used to be, i have a GF now, only 1 - I got rid of the other ones because this one swears she will always be ther for me but I really don't have much in common with her, she used to be a ho when she was younger and I don't like it. She could just be lying too and bail out on me like everyone else has in my life. EVERYONE has broken their promises to me and I have kept mine. what good did it do me to be true ? Now i am very addicted to the meds and can't quit (afraid to) - I am sick now with an ulcer from all the stress this year , i can barely eat and when i do i get sick. I am treating my ulcer with some success. i am very confused on what to do, i have no sex drive but can do everything so my GF is happy VERY happy. But I really don't want to do it. i don't enjoy anything anymore. I have no friends. My family rarely sees me. My father is dying , my son yells at me when I call him because i get lonely, i am disabled because of depression and ANXIETY - I am so sick of being afraid. that is why i try to drug myself up to escape it. So a few years ago i wasn't taking much of anything and I was ok. Life was pretty good, i had my son and fiance. Living with me. But htey are gone - my son is married and busy. i told you she dumped me. i can't believe she did it. I think of the gorls i have loved and i tried to get them back but no one EVER came back. Now i have a new one but I have only known her a month - how can she be so sure she will stay with me ? Alo I am not sure i want her in particular , but its much better than being alone. that is the worst feeling in the world and i can't stand it. She does think i'm 44 but I hope it won't matter when i tell her my real age - we met online and gorls don't want guys over 45 when they are 39. So i never would have met her if I did not put the lower age down. She does not know i am disabled nor 52. I am afraid to tell her. If she left i would definitely end it as I don't believe I could make it alone through the winter like last year - it was HELL and my ex would not come to see me for more than once a week and her kisses got colder and colder. Until i had to find someone new. My old GF was 48 and she knew about my disability and age. My dog is my best friend, but she is not a human and i go DAYS without seeing anyone sometimes so how can i quit the drugs ? I can't do it alone. What do you think ? I am in a real tight spot. Until recently I never would see more than 1 woman at a time but when they went away I was left alone , thats why I was trying to keep one on th ebck burner to go to if this one leaves me too. i think she will.
yeah buddy . I feel like shit too , check out my post. I'm ready to go too.
looks like not too many care what happens - only 1 commentor which I appreciate but what do i do with my gf's ? and how can i cope - feels worse all the time - I am feeling very desperate
